scoreboard_title: Timephoria's skintint push leads; Glad2Glow and Skintific also moved
movers_title: Three brands moved outside their normal range

drivers.title: Timephoria's skintint stick: big reach, thin engagement
drivers.why: Mid-tier reviewers carried a new skintint stick: 125 creators posted, double last week's 62, and Instagram views rose from 81K to 34.5M. Engagement stayed at 0.2%, so the reach looks paid rather than earned.
drivers.attention_to_action: Reviews built awareness, but Instagram has no cart and engagement is thin. Watch whether the stick reaches TikTok Shop next.

drivers.title: Glad2Glow's cushion tutorials lifted engagement
drivers.why: One mid-tier creator, @chika_adelia16, posted two cushion tutorials worth 5.9M views; the bigger one alone was 35% of the brand's week. Nano creators rose to 58% of creator posts while brand accounts fell to 19% of views.
drivers.attention_to_action: Tutorials drove engagement, but cart share fell from 66% to 49%: the cushion won attention without a matching push to buy.

drivers.title: Skintific seeded a cushion hashtag through new creators
drivers.why: Skintific's posts fell 25% while the TikTok panel fell 49%, lifting its share of posts to 5.5%. 82% of its creators were first-time in 8 weeks, and 15 used #skintificcushion, a tag no other brand used.
drivers.attention_to_action: Volume without reach: 1.2M views in the week and cart share down from 42% to 26%. The tag makes the seeding easy to track, not yet to sell.

actions.title: Shift Nano slots into Mid-tier creators
actions.detail: Mid-tier is 6% of Paragon's creator posts but 51% of its views, and a Mid-tier post earns a 21K median against 593 for Nano. Cut the weakest Nano posts and brief Mid-tier creators for Wardah and Make Over before 7.7.

actions.title: Post fewer, bigger TikToks from brand accounts
actions.detail: Paragon's 201 brand-account TikToks drew 10.9M views at a 4K median; Hanasui's 20 drew 13.1M at a 105K median, 86% of its TikTok views. Cut the weakest daily posts and put media behind two or three hero videos a week.

actions.title: Meet the skintint stick where people buy
actions.detail: Timephoria's skin tint posts drew 16.4M views, but its Instagram engagement was 0.2% and Instagram has no cart. Answer with a Make Over base review series on TikTok with cart links, where the same shopper is closer to checkout.

actions.title: Give Emina's next launch one seeding tag
actions.detail: Glad2Glow's #brighteninggelmask put 62 accounts behind one mask for 12.9M views, 25% of its week. Give Emina's next launch a single tag and a one-post brief per creator, so each wave reads as one number week by week.

actions.title: Pilot tutorial briefs for the cushion line
actions.detail: Glad2Glow's TikTok engagement rose to 3.8% on two cushion tutorials by @chika_adelia16 worth 4.0M and 1.9M views. Pilot five tutorial briefs for Wardah's cushion and compare engagement against its showcase posts.

portfolio_note: Kahf's Instagram views rose from 909K to 19.1M, lifting Paragon's Instagram engagement rate from 2.0% to 8.4%.

tiers.title: Paragon's views come from Mid-tier; most of its posts are Nano
tiers.takeaway: Mid-tier is 6% of Paragon's creator posts but 51% of its views; Nano is 82% of posts for 11%. Glad2Glow gets 39% of views from Nano.

products.title: Rivals win views on one hero product; Paragon spreads thin
products.takeaway: Glad2Glow's 71 mask posts drew 13.5M views and Skintific's 51 serum posts 72.7M; Paragon's 288 lip posts drew 1.4M.

posting.title: Paragon talks 6.6 most; Timephoria grew with no promo at all
posting.takeaway: Paragon wrote 40 double-date captions and Glad2Glow 22, while Timephoria put promo language in 0% of posts and still landed 38% of its views in one day.

patterns.takeaway: #brighteninggelmask: 63 posts from 62 accounts brought 12.9M views, 25% of Glad2Glow's week. One tag, one product, about one post per creator.
